title: Can LLMs Speak For Diverse People? Tuning LLMs via Debate to Generate Controllable Controversial Statements

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating 'Controversy Controllability' by prompting a GPT-4 judge to analyze model responses to controversial topics and calculate the proportion of arguments that support versus oppose a given stance. This tests whether the model can strictly adhere to assigned viewpoints (including minority perspectives) rather than defaulting to a biased 'safe middle ground' or majority consensus.
